mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1600K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals a pickup in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window for INDPRO signals.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% indicates slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors reassess growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 drops below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above its 3-month moving average, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and rising inflation leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 50bp in 1q and CPIAUCSL > 3mo MA
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in two consecutive months signals a labor market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the surprise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when the UNRATE surprise occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent year-over-year increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 5% signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market anticipates sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window for RSAFS signals.
